recent_excerpts: BufferZoneCorp account published malicious Ruby gems and Go modules that steal credentials, tamper with GitHub Actions, and establish SSH persistence in CI pipelines.
Attackers compromised SAP, Lightning, and Intercom npm packages in a supply chain attack affecting 1,800 victims; packages had 10M monthly downloads.
Atos TRC identified EtherRAT in March 2026 — a remote access trojan distributed through fake GitHub repos impersonating admin utilities.
